source_limitations: Cambridge publisher search-index snippets were observed 2026-11-02. Direct Cambridge page requests returned HTTP 403. Indexed CEFR labels are research leads, not independently checked exact-sense classification or independent English/Myanmar/example verification. All six alternatives are unapproved; no audio was listened to.

frozen_original.english_definition: A company or person that makes goods, usually in large quantities.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: ကုန်ပစ္စည်းထုတ်လုပ်သူ၊ ထုတ်လုပ်ရေးကုမ္ပဏီ
frozen_original.example_sentence: The manufacturer recalled the product after discovering a defect.

cambridge.editorial_observation: Cambridge indexed B2 countable noun is a goods-producing company; frozen 'company or person' is broader than the labelled sense. Review whether person sense is intended.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: A business that makes products, especially in large quantities.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: ကုန်ပစ္စည်းများကို အများအပြား ထုတ်လုပ်သည့် ကုမ္ပဏီ
unapproved_teaching_alternative.example_sentence: The manufacturer replaced the defective parts without charging customers.

review_needed: British George/Emma headword and example audio listening

frozen_original.english_definition: Situated near or relating to the sea coast.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: ကမ်းရိုးတန်းနှင့်ဆိုင်သော
frozen_original.example_sentence: Coastal communities are preparing for stronger storms.

cambridge.editorial_observation: Cambridge indexed B2 adjective covers location on/near or relation to a coast. Frozen C1 sense/example appears aligned with this B2 meaning.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: Located near the sea or connected with the coast.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: ပင်လယ်ကမ်းရိုးတန်းအနီးရှိသော၊ ကမ်းရိုးတန်းနှင့် သက်ဆိုင်သော
unapproved_teaching_alternative.example_sentence: Coastal villages received warnings before the storm arrived.

review_needed: British George/Emma headword and example audio listening

frozen_original.english_definition: A physical or mental condition that can affect a person's ability to do certain activities.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: မသန်စွမ်းမှု၊ လုပ်ဆောင်နိုင်စွမ်းကို ထိခိုက်စေနိုင်သော အခြေအနေ
frozen_original.example_sentence: The company improved access for people with a disability.

cambridge.editorial_observation: Cambridge indexed B2 condition sense; frozen C1 meaning is similar but 'can affect' may understate an actual functional limitation. Independently review person-first wording and avoid implying all disabilities are visible.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: A long-term condition that can make certain activities harder for a person.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: အချို့သော လှုပ်ရှားလုပ်ဆောင်မှုများကို ခက်ခဲစေနိုင်သည့် ရေရှည် မသန်စွမ်းမှုအခြေအနေ
unapproved_teaching_alternative.example_sentence: The museum added ramps to improve access for visitors with disabilities.

frozen_original.english_definition: An official document giving permission for a particular activity.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: တရားဝင်ခွင့်ပြုချက်လက်မှတ်
frozen_original.example_sentence: The contractor applied for a permit before starting work.

cambridge.editorial_observation: Cambridge noun document sense C1; verb 'allow' B1 and verb 'make possible' C1 are separate. British noun /ˈpɜː.mɪt/ versus verb /pəˈmɪt/ requires separate real audio listening; a shared headword clip is unsafe without POS.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: An official document that allows someone to do a particular activity or enter a place.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: တစ်စုံတစ်ရာ ပြုလုပ်ရန် သို့မဟုတ် နေရာတစ်ခုသို့ ဝင်ရောက်ရန် တရားဝင် ခွင့်ပြုထားသည့် စာရွက်စာတမ်း
unapproved_teaching_alternative.example_sentence: The builder must obtain a permit before beginning construction.

frozen_original.english_definition: An occasion when money, goods, or services are exchanged.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: ငွေကြေး သို့မဟုတ် ကုန်ပစ္စည်း အရောင်းအဝယ်ပြုလုပ်မှု
frozen_original.example_sentence: The bank sent a receipt for the transaction.

cambridge.editorial_observation: Cambridge indexed C1 buying/selling or money-exchange sense matches the bank example. Frozen 'goods or services exchanged' could be broader than publisher CEFR-labelled buying/selling/money scope.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: An occasion when someone buys or sells something or money is transferred.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: ကုန်ပစ္စည်း အရောင်းအဝယ်ပြုလုပ်ခြင်း သို့မဟုတ် ငွေကြေး လွှဲပြောင်းခြင်းတစ်ကြိမ်
unapproved_teaching_alternative.example_sentence: The bank recorded the transaction immediately after the transfer.

frozen_original.english_definition: The likelihood that an event will happen.
frozen_original.example_sentence: The probability of rain is higher in the afternoon.

cambridge.editorial_observation: Cambridge indexed C1 likelihood sense aligns with frozen example. Distinguish a chance/likelihood from a mathematically computed probability and from the C2 phrase 'in all probability'.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: How likely it is that something will happen or be true.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: အဖြစ်အပျက်တစ်ခု ဖြစ်ပေါ်လာနိုင်သည့် အလားအလာအတိုင်းအတာ
unapproved_teaching_alternative.example_sentence: The team estimated the probability of delays during the rainy season.
